WITH kept AS (
  SELECT driverId, points, wins
  FROM driverStandings
  WHERE points > 1.0
), per_driver AS (
  SELECT driverId,
         AVG(points) AS average_points,
         AVG(wins) AS average_wins
  FROM kept
  GROUP BY driverId
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS mean_average_wins
  FROM per_driver
)
SELECT p.driverId,
       p.average_points,
       p.average_wins,
       p.average_wins - o.mean_average_wins AS difference
FROM per_driver AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.mean_average_wins IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
